sections.service: Connection to the two routing services the environment depends on: VROOM solves the vehicle routing plans and OSRM supplies the road travel times. The config names their endpoints, the size of the in-process cache of VROOM solutions and the solver options passed with every request.
sections.io: Filesystem layout of a run: where run directories live, what the run is called, where its logs go, which checkpoint file it writes, and which earlier run it resumes or warm-starts from.
sections.environment: The scenario generator and the disruption process. A scenario places a depot and a set of jobs and vehicles around a city centre; an episode then alternates disruption rounds (jobs and vehicles added or removed after an exponential gap) with edit bursts by the agent. The config sets the area, the job and fleet size distributions, service times, disruption gaps and event counts, and the base seed of the sampler.
sections.learning: Optimiser schedule of PPO training: one learning rate per network head with warmup and decay to a floor, and the annealed entropy bonus that keeps the operator, vehicle and job distributions exploratory early in training.
sections.model: Architecture of the graph policy: the input feature widths fixed by the state encoder, the operator and context embeddings, the graph neural network over jobs and vehicles, and the hidden widths of the actor heads and the critic.
sections.training: The PPO training loop and the episode caps shared by every entry point: device, number of updates, episodes collected per update, minibatching and epochs, the number of disruption rounds per episode and the edit cap per round.
sections.reward: The reward the agent maximises: weighted changes of route distance, unassigned jobs, idle vehicles and unassigned priority, minus a fixed cost per operator and a cost per job moved between vehicles, with unassigned work accruing a holding cost over the time until the next disruption.
sections.ppo: Proximal policy optimisation: discounting and advantage estimation, the clipped surrogate objective, value loss and gradient clipping, the KL threshold that stops an update early, and the annealed KL anchor to the initial policy that protects a behaviour-cloned warm start.
sections.pretraining: Behaviour cloning of the regret-insertion teacher: how many teacher episodes are collected, how they are rolled out in parallel, and the epochs, batch size and learning rate of the supervised fit that warm-starts the policy before PPO.
sections.evaluation: The held-out evaluation that writes a run's evaluation report: number of episodes, the base seed of the held-out band and whether the policy acts greedily.
sections.telemetry: Sampling gates of the TensorBoard telemetry written during training: how often step, episode, sample and per-layer gradient statistics are logged.
sections.inference: Single-episode inference: the scenario seed of the random episode and whether the policy acts greedily.
sections.monitor: Resource monitor running beside training: polling interval, whether it logs to TensorBoard, and the RAM, VRAM, swap and shared-memory levels that raise a warning.
sections.diagnostics: Trace recording for the Diagnose tab: the held-out episodes, the agents recorded on each, whether the model also records a sampled twin, and how much of the teacher's decision table is computed on every model decision.

service::ServiceConfig.summary: Endpoints and solver options of the VROOM and OSRM services

fields.vroom_url: Base URL of the VROOM solver the environment sends every routing problem to
fields.osrm_url: Base URL of the OSRM server that answers travel-time tables and route geometry
fields.solve_cache_limit: Maximum number of VROOM solutions kept in the in-process cache before it is cleared
fields.options: Solver options sent with every VROOM request, such as g for returning route geometry; not overridable from the command line
fields._http_session: Shared HTTP session with a pooled adapter, created on first use; internal, not a setting

io::IOConfig.summary: Run directory, log directory, checkpoint name and the run to resume or warm-start from

fields.runs_dir: Directory holding every run directory, relative to the repository root
fields.run_name: Run directory under runs_dir; empty picks a timestamped name for training and must name an existing run for evaluate, infer and diagnose
fields.logdir: Directory of the run's logs and TensorBoard events; empty uses the run directory
fields.checkpoint_filename: File name of the policy checkpoint inside the run directory
fields.resume_from_run: Run whose checkpoint and optimiser state training continues from; exclusive with init_from_run
fields.init_from_run: Run whose weights initialise a new training run, typically a behaviour-cloning pretrain; exclusive with resume_from_run

environment::EnvironmentConfig.summary: Scenario area, job and fleet distributions, service times and the disruption process

fields.center: City centre as longitude, latitude in degrees; jobs and the depot are placed around it
fields.radius: Radius in km of the disc jobs are sampled in, before the outlier multiplier
fields.depot_radius: Radius in km of the disc around the centre the depot is placed in
fields.depot_service: Unloading time in s at the depot after a repossession pickup; must match the value the console's VROOM client uses
fields.repossession_fraction: Share of jobs that are repossession pickups rather than support visits
fields.repossession_success_probability: Probability that a repossession pickup finds the motorcycle and returns it to the depot
fields.support_service_min: Lower bound in s of the uniform service time of a support visit
fields.support_service_max: Upper bound in s of the uniform service time of a support visit
fields.repossession_service_min: Lower bound in s of the uniform service time of a repossession pickup
fields.repossession_service_max: Upper bound in s of the uniform service time of a repossession pickup
fields.job_setup_min: Lower bound in s of the uniform setup time added before a job
fields.job_setup_max: Upper bound in s of the uniform setup time added before a job
fields.disruption_gap_mean: Mean in s of the exponential wait until the next disruption; vehicles execute their routes forward by the sampled wait
fields.disruption_gap_min: Lower clamp in s on the sampled wait between disruptions
fields.disruption_gap_max: Upper clamp in s on the sampled wait between disruptions
fields.min_vehicles: Smallest fleet a scenario may have
fields.min_jobs: Smallest number of jobs a scenario may start with
fields.mean_jobs: Mean of the normal distribution of the initial job count
fields.std_jobs: Standard deviation of the initial job count
fields.mean_vehicles: Mean of the normal distribution of the fleet size
fields.std_vehicles: Standard deviation of the fleet size
fields.reset_max_attempts: Number of scenarios sampled at reset before giving up when VROOM finds no solution
fields.scenario_seed: Base seed of inline scenario sampling; training episode i uses scenario_seed plus i
fields.outlier_frequency: One job in this many is an outlier placed farther out; 0 disables outliers
fields.outlier_multiplier: Factor applied to the radius for outlier jobs
fields.job_insert_min: Fewest jobs added by one job-insertion disruption
fields.job_insert_max: Most jobs added by one job-insertion disruption
fields.job_remove_min: Fewest jobs cancelled by one job-removal disruption
fields.job_remove_max: Most jobs cancelled by one job-removal disruption
fields.vehicle_insert_min: Fewest vehicles added by one vehicle-insertion disruption
fields.vehicle_insert_max: Most vehicles added by one vehicle-insertion disruption
fields.vehicle_remove_min: Fewest vehicles withdrawn by one vehicle-removal disruption
fields.vehicle_remove_max: Most vehicles withdrawn by one vehicle-removal disruption

learning::LearningRate.summary: Per-head learning rates with linear warmup and decay to a floor

fields.lr_operator_actor: Learning rate of the operator head that chooses insert, remove or do nothing
fields.lr_vehicle_actor: Learning rate of the vehicle head
fields.lr_critic: Learning rate of the value head
fields.lr_embedding: Learning rate of the graph encoder shared by all heads
fields.lr_job_actor: Learning rate of the job head
fields.lr_operator_embedding: Learning rate of the operator embedding that conditions the vehicle and job heads
fields.lr_min: Floor every learning rate decays to
fields.lr_warmup_fraction: Share of the projected optimiser steps spent warming up linearly from zero
fields.lr_decay_fraction: Share of the projected optimiser steps over which the rates decay to lr_min

learning::Entropy.summary: Annealed entropy bonus of the policy loss

fields.entropy_start: Entropy coefficient at the start of training
fields.entropy_end: Entropy coefficient at the end of the anneal
fields.entropy_anneal_fraction: Share of training over which the coefficient anneals from start to end

model::ModelConfig.summary: Input widths, embeddings and hidden sizes of the graph policy

fields.job_input_dim: Number of features per job node; fixed by the state encoder
fields.vehicle_input_dim: Number of features per vehicle node; fixed by the state encoder
fields.edge_attr_dim: Number of features per job-vehicle edge; fixed by the state encoder
fields.context_input_dim: Number of global context features; fixed by the state encoder
fields.num_operators: Number of operators the policy chooses from: insert, remove and do nothing
fields.operator_embedding_dim: Width of the embedding of the chosen operator
fields.context_embedding_dim: Width of the embedding of the global context
fields.gnn_num_layers: Number of message-passing layers of the graph encoder
fields.policy_gnn_hidden_channels: Hidden width of the graph encoder layers
fields.policy_embedding_dim: Width of the node embeddings the heads read
fields.policy_actor_hidden_1: First hidden width of the actor heads
fields.policy_actor_hidden_2: Second hidden width of the actor heads
fields.value_critic_hidden_1: First hidden width of the critic
fields.value_critic_hidden_2: Second hidden width of the critic

training::TrainingConfig.summary: Device, loop sizes and episode caps of training

fields.device: Torch device of the policy, cuda or cpu
fields.max_disruptions_per_episode: Number of disruption rounds per episode; each round is a disruption followed by the agent's edit burst
fields.max_edits_per_round: Most edits the agent may make at frozen time before the world advances; choosing do nothing ends the burst early
fields.num_updates: Number of PPO updates; each collects episodes_per_update fresh episodes
fields.expected_edits_per_round: Expected edits per round, used only to project the number of optimiser steps for the learning-rate schedule
fields.num_epochs: Passes over the collected batch per update
fields.use_mixed_precision: Run the forward and backward passes in mixed precision
fields.large_negative_value: Logit given to masked actions so they get zero probability

reward::RewardConfig.summary: Weights of the plan cost terms and the costs of each edit

fields.distance_weight: Weight per km of planned route distance
fields.idle_penalty_weight: Penalty per vehicle with no stops
fields.priority_penalty_weight: Penalty per unit of priority left unassigned
fields.add_job_cost: Fixed cost of an insert edit
fields.remove_job_cost: Fixed cost of a remove edit
fields.no_action_cost: Fixed cost of choosing do nothing
fields.disruption_cost: Cost per job an edit moves to another vehicle
fields.holding_reference_seconds: Seconds over which an unassigned job accrues its full unassigned and priority cost while the world advances

ppo::PPOConfig.summary: Discounting, clipped objective, early stopping and the KL anchor

fields.gamma: Discount factor of returns; also discounts the teacher's plan value in pretraining
fields.clip_ratio: Clip range of the probability ratio in the surrogate objective
fields.value_loss_coef: Weight of the value loss in the total loss
fields.kl_divergence_threshold: Approximate KL to the collecting policy at which an update stops its remaining epochs
fields.anchor_kl_start: Weight of the KL penalty to the initial policy at the start of training; 0 disables the anchor
fields.anchor_kl_end: Weight of the KL anchor at the end of its anneal
fields.anchor_anneal_fraction: Share of training over which the anchor weight anneals

pretraining::PretrainConfig.summary: Teacher rollouts and the supervised fit of behaviour cloning

fields.episodes: Number of teacher episodes collected as cloning data
fields.bc_epochs: Passes over the collected teacher decisions
fields.lr: Learning rate of the cloning fit
fields.value_loss_coef: Weight of the value regression on the teacher's returns
fields.plan_horizon: Number of insertions the teacher's greedy plan looks ahead, capped by the edits left in the round
fields.collect_workers: Fork workers for teacher rollouts; 0 means the CPU count minus 2
fields.collect_batch_size: Episodes handed to a worker at a time

evaluation::EvaluationConfig.summary: Held-out evaluation of a checkpoint against the baselines

fields.seed: Base seed of the held-out band; must not overlap the training band starting at the scenario seed
fields.greedy: Take the most probable action; sampling is not comparable with the deterministic baselines

telemetry::TelemetryConfig.summary: How often training telemetry is logged

fields.step_every: Log step statistics every this many steps
fields.episode_every: Log episode statistics every this many episodes
fields.sample_every: Log sampled decision details every this many samples
fields.layer_gradients_every: Log per-layer gradient norms every this many gradient steps

inference::InferenceConfig.summary: Seed and action selection of a single inference episode

fields.seed: Scenario seed of the random episode
fields.greedy: Take the most probable action instead of sampling

fields.enabled: Run the resource monitor beside training
fields.warn_ram_pct: RAM use in percent that raises a warning
fields.warn_vram_pct: GPU memory use in percent that raises a warning
fields.warn_swap_pct: Swap use in percent that raises a warning
fields.warn_shm_pct: Shared-memory use in percent that raises a warning
fields.warn_cooldown_sec: Seconds before the same warning may repeat

diagnostics::DiagnosticsConfig.summary: Episodes, agents and teacher verdicts of trace recording

fields.seed: Base seed of the episode band; when the run holds an evaluation report for this seed, environment, reward and caps are taken from it
fields.agents: Agents recorded on every episode, a subset of model, teacher, insertion_only and do_nothing; a teacher trace takes 30 to 150 s per episode
fields.greedy: The model takes its most probable action
fields.sampled_twin: Also record the model sampling from its distribution, as agent model_sampled
fields.teacher_verdict: Teacher table computed on every model decision: none, insertions (0.5 to 3 s per decision) or full (up to 17 s)
